strongest_angle: Investigating cultural critic Chuck Klosterman's 14th book, Rock*, which explores an alternative history where the Velvet Underground's 1967 debut album supplanted the Beatles as the defining commercial and cultural force in rock music.

key_facts.fact: Cultural critic Chuck Klosterman published his 14th book titled Rock*: A Mainstream Alternative History of Alternative Mainstream Music in 2026.
In the alternate history constructed by author Chuck Klosterman in Rock*, the 1967 album The Velvet Underground and Nico becomes the biggest-selling and most culturally influential record in history.
Chuck Klosterman's 14th book, Rock*, maps a fictional universe where the public spurns Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band as corny.
